exposure: Socioeconomic status (lowest income quartile vs higher income quartiles)
Low socioeconomic status (lowest income quartile vs higher income quartiles)
outcome: Other pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal outcomes
cohort: Women with an ICD-9 diagnosis of PCOS in the US who delivered in the third trimester or had a maternal death (2004-2014)
finding: In PCOS patients, low socioeconomic status increases the risk for pregnancy-induced hypertension, pre-eclampsia, and cesarean delivery.
